translations.literal: Husband and wife wished to die together; the lady took leave of Ningxi, saying, "To die together is indeed sweet, but you still have no son and your old mother is at home—please flee quickly; tomorrow morning you may seek me at this place.
translations.idiomatic: The couple wished to die together. Lady Feng took leave of Ningxi and said, "To die together would indeed be sweet, but you still have no son and your old mother is at home. Please flee quickly. Tomorrow morning you may seek me at this place.

sentences.zh: 」凝禧遂逃，次早果得屍於分手處。

translations.literal: " Ningxi then fled, and the next morning indeed found her corpse at the place where they had parted.
translations.idiomatic: " Ningxi fled. The next morning he indeed found her corpse at the place where they had parted.

sentences.zh: 唐烈妻陳氏。

translations.literal: Chen, wife of Tang Lie.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Chen, wife of Tang Lie.

sentences.zh: 烈，孝感諸生。

translations.literal: Lie was a student of Xiaogan.
translations.idiomatic: Lie was a licentiate of Xiaogan.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年，從夫避難山砦。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chongzhen she followed her husband to take refuge in a mountain stockade.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of the Chongzhen reign she followed her husband to take refuge in a mountain stockade.

sentences.zh: 賊突至，夫與子俱奔散，陳獨行山谷間。

translations.literal: Bandits suddenly arrived; husband and son both fled and scattered, while Chen walked alone through valleys and hills.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits suddenly arrived. Her husband and son both fled and scattered, while Chen walked alone through the valleys.

sentences.zh: 砦人曰：「非唐氏嫗乎？

translations.literal: People of the stockade said, "Is this not old Mrs. Tang?
translations.idiomatic: People in the stockade said, "Is this not old Mrs. Tang?

sentences.zh: 事迫矣，可急入保。

translations.literal: The situation is urgent—you should hurry in for protection.
translations.idiomatic: The situation is urgent. You should hurry inside for protection.

sentences.zh: 」陳問夫與子至未，曰：「未也。

translations.literal: " Chen asked whether her husband and son had arrived; they said, "Not yet.
translations.idiomatic: " Chen asked whether her husband and son had arrived. They said, "Not yet.

sentences.zh: 」陳泣曰：「我煢煢一婦人，靡因而至。

translations.literal: " Chen wept and said, "I am a solitary woman, with no one to rely on when I arrive.
translations.idiomatic: " Chen wept and said, "I am a solitary woman with no one to rely on when I arrive.

sentences.zh: 諸君雖憐而生我，我何面目安茲土耶！

translations.literal: Though you all pity me and would let me live, what face have I to settle on this ground!
translations.idiomatic: Though you pity me and would let me live, what face have I to settle on this ground!

sentences.zh: 夫存亡未知，依人以生不貞，棄夫之難不義。

translations.literal: My husband's life or death is unknown; to live by leaning on others is unchaste, and to abandon my husband in hardship is unrighteous.
translations.idiomatic: My husband's fate is unknown. To live by leaning on others is unchaste, and to abandon my husband in hardship is unrighteous.

sentences.zh: 失貞與義，何以為人！

translations.literal: To lose chastity and righteousness—how can one remain human!
translations.idiomatic: To lose chastity and righteousness—how can one remain human!

sentences.zh: 吾其行也。

translations.literal: I shall go.
translations.idiomatic: I shall go.

sentences.zh: 」卒不入。

translations.literal: " In the end she did not enter.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end she did not enter.

sentences.zh: 已，賊至，逼去不從，大罵死。

translations.literal: Afterward bandits arrived; they pressed her to leave but she would not obey, cursed them bitterly, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the bandits arrived. They pressed her to leave, but she refused. She cursed them bitterly and died.

sentences.zh: 又劉氏，懷寧人，應天府丞顏素之孫婦也。

translations.literal: Also Lady Liu, a native of Huaining, was granddaughter-in-law of Yan Suzhi, assistant prefect of Yingtian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Lady Liu of Huaining, granddaughter-in-law of Yan Suzhi, assistant prefect of Yingtian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 崇禎末，亂兵焚掠江市。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongzhen, disorderly troops burned and plundered the river market.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Chongzhen reign, disorderly troops burned and plundered the river market.

sentences.zh: 其舅與夫先在南京。

translations.literal: Her uncle and husband were already in Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Her uncle and husband were already in Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 劉孑身出避，倉皇無所之，見男婦雜走登舟，慨然曰：「吾儕婦人，保姆不在，義不出帷，敢亂群乎！

translations.literal: Liu fled alone; in panic she had nowhere to go, and seeing men and women mixed together rushing to board boats, she said with feeling, "We are women; with no nursemaid present, by propriety we do not leave the inner quarters—how dare we mix into the crowd!
translations.idiomatic: Liu fled alone. In her panic she had nowhere to go. Seeing men and women mixed together rushing to board boats, she said with feeling, "We are women. With no nursemaid present, by propriety we do not leave the inner quarters. How dare we mix into the crowd!

sentences.zh: 」遂投江死。

translations.literal: " She then threw herself into the river and died.
translations.idiomatic: " She then threw herself into the river and died.

sentences.zh: 唐氏，廣濟潘龍躍妻。

translations.literal: Lady Tang, wife of Pan Longyue of Guangji.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Tang, wife of Pan Longyue of Guangji.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十三年避賊靈果山。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chongzhen they fled bandits to Lingguo Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Chongzhen reign they fled bandits to Lingguo Mountain.

sentences.zh: 賊至，加刃龍躍頸，索錢。

translations.literal: When bandits arrived they pressed a blade to Longyue's neck and demanded money.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits arrived they pressed a blade to Longyue's neck and demanded money.

sentences.zh: 唐跪泣，乞以身代夫，不許。

translations.literal: Tang knelt and wept, begging to die in her husband's place; they would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Tang knelt and wept, begging to die in her husband's place. They refused.

sentences.zh: 女巽跪泣，乞以身代父，不許。

translations.literal: The daughter Sun knelt and wept, begging to die in her father's place; they would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: Their daughter Sun knelt and wept, begging to die in her father's place. They refused.

sentences.zh: 唐知夫不免，投於塘，女從之。

translations.literal: Tang knew her husband could not escape, threw herself into a pond, and the daughter followed.
translations.idiomatic: Tang knew her husband could not escape. She threw herself into a pond, and their daughter followed.

sentences.zh: 賊愴然釋其夫。

translations.literal: The bandits, moved to sorrow, released her husband.
translations.idiomatic: Moved to sorrow, the bandits released her husband.

sentences.zh: 又顏氏，長樂諸生黃應運妻。

translations.literal: Also Lady Yan, wife of Huang Yingyun, a student of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Lady Yan, wife of Huang Yingyun, a licentiate of Changle.

sentences.zh: 城陷，兵至其家，欲殺應運生母詹氏，顏泣訴，願身代。

translations.literal: When the city fell, soldiers came to their home and intended to kill Yingyun's birth mother, Lady Zhan; Yan wept and pleaded, wishing to die in her place.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, soldiers came to their home intending to kill Yingyun's birth mother, Lady Zhan. Yan wept and pleaded to die in her place.

sentences.zh: 及顏方受刃，妾曾又奔號曰：「此我主母，無所出，願殺我以全其命。

translations.literal: When Yan was about to receive the blade, the concubine Zeng again ran forward crying, "This is my mistress; she has borne no children—kill me instead to spare her life.
translations.idiomatic: When Yan was about to receive the blade, the concubine Zeng ran forward again, crying, "This is my mistress. She has borne no children. Kill me instead to spare her life.

sentences.zh: 」卒感其義，兩釋之。

translations.literal: " The soldiers were moved by their righteousness and released both.
translations.idiomatic: " The soldiers were moved by their righteousness and released them both.

sentences.zh: 潁州盧氏，王瀚妻。

translations.literal: Lady Lu of Yingzhou, wife of Wang Han.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Lu of Yingzhou, wife of Wang Han.

sentences.zh: 家貧，舂織終歲。

translations.literal: The family was poor; she pounded grain and wove cloth the year round.
translations.idiomatic: The family was poor. She pounded grain and wove cloth the year round.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十四年大饑，夫患疫。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Chongzhen there was a great famine, and her husband fell ill with plague.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of the Chongzhen reign there was a great famine, and her husband fell ill with plague.

sentences.zh: 氏語夫曰：「君死，我當從。

translations.literal: The wife told her husband, "When you die, I shall follow.
translations.idiomatic: She told her husband, "When you die, I shall follow.

sentences.zh: 」及夫死，時溽暑，氏求親戚斂錢以葬曰：「我當死，但酷熱無衣棺，恐更為親戚累，遲之秋爽耳。

translations.literal: " When her husband died it was sweltering summer; the wife asked relatives to gather money for burial, saying, "I ought to die, but in this fierce heat we have no shroud or coffin—I fear burdening my kin further; I will delay until the cool of autumn.
translations.idiomatic: " When her husband died it was the height of summer. She asked relatives to gather money for the burial and said, "I ought to die, but in this fierce heat we have no shroud or coffin. I fear burdening my kin further, so I will wait until the cool of autumn.

sentences.zh: 」聞者咍之。

translations.literal: " Those who heard sneered at her.
translations.idiomatic: " Those who heard sneered at her.

sentences.zh: 及秋，盡糶其新谷，置粗布衣，余買酒蔬祀夫墓。

translations.literal: When autumn came she sold all her new grain, bought coarse cloth garments, and with what remained purchased wine and vegetables to offer at her husband's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: When autumn came she sold all her new grain and bought coarse cloth garments. With what remained she purchased wine and vegetables to offer at her husband's tomb.

sentences.zh: 歸至家，市梨數十進姑，並貽妯娌，語人曰：「我可死矣。

translations.literal: Returning home she bought several dozen pears to present to her mother-in-law and also gave some to her sisters-in-law, telling people, "I can die now.
translations.idiomatic: Returning home she bought several dozen pears for her mother-in-law and also gave some to her sisters-in-law. She told people, "I can die now.

sentences.zh: 」夜半自縊。

translations.literal: " At midnight she hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: " At midnight she hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 於氏，汝州張鐸妻。

translations.literal: Lady Yu, wife of Zhang Duo of Ruzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yu, wife of Zhang Duo of Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十四年，賊破城，氏謂兩婢曰：「吾輩今日必死，曷若先出擊賊，殺賊而斃，不失為義烈鬼。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Chongzhen bandits breached the city; the lady told the two maidservants, "We must die today—why not go out first and strike the bandits? To kill bandits and then perish is no disgrace as righteous martyrs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of the Chongzhen reign bandits breached the city. Lady Yu told the two maidservants, "We must die today. Why not go out first and strike the bandits? To kill bandits and then perish would be no disgrace as righteous martyrs.

sentences.zh: 」於是執梃而前，賊先入者三，出不意，悉為所踣。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they took clubs and advanced; three bandits who entered first were caught off guard and all were knocked down by them.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they took clubs and advanced. Three bandits who entered first were caught off guard, and the women knocked them all down.

sentences.zh: 群賊怒，攢刺之，皆死。

translations.literal: The bandits in a body were enraged, gathered round and stabbed them, and all died.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits were enraged. They gathered round and stabbed them, and all three died.

sentences.zh: 蕭氏，萬安賴南叔妻。

translations.literal: Lady Xiao, wife of Lai Nanshu of Wan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Xiao, wife of Lai Nanshu of Wan'an.

sentences.zh: 夫早喪，無子，遺一女。

translations.literal: Her husband died early; she had no son and left behind one daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Her husband died early. She had no son and was left with one daughter.

sentences.zh: 寇大起，築室與女共居。

translations.literal: When banditry rose greatly she built a dwelling and lived there with her daughter.
translations.idiomatic: When banditry flared she built a dwelling and lived there with her daughter.

sentences.zh: 盜突至，率女持利刃遮門，詈曰：「昔寧化曾氏婦，立砦殺賊。

translations.literal: Robbers suddenly arrived; leading her daughter she took sharp blades and blocked the door, cursing, "In former times the wife of the Zeng clan at Ninghua built a stockade and killed bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Robbers suddenly arrived. Leading her daughter, she took sharp blades and blocked the door, cursing, "In former times the wife of the Zeng clan at Ninghua built a stockade and killed bandits.

sentences.zh: 汝謂我刃不利邪！

translations.literal: Do you think my blade is not sharp!
translations.idiomatic: Do you think my blade is not sharp!

sentences.zh: 犯我必殺汝。

translations.literal: If you violate me I will surely kill you.
translations.idiomatic: If you violate me I will surely kill you.

sentences.zh: 」賊怒，縱火焚之，二人鹹燼。

translations.literal: " The bandits were enraged, set fire and burned them, and both were reduced to ashes.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits were enraged, set fire, and burned them. Both mother and daughter were reduced to ashes.

sentences.zh: 又楊氏，安定舉人張國纮妾。

translations.literal: Also Lady Yang, concubine of the Ding'an licentiate Zhang Guohong.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Lady Yang, concubine of the Ding'an licentiate Zhang Guohong.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十六年，賊賀錦攻城急。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chongzhen the bandit He Jin pressed the siege of the city fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of the Chongzhen reign the bandit He Jin pressed the siege of the city fiercely.

sentences.zh: 國纮與守者議，丁壯登陴，女子運石。

translations.literal: Guohong discussed with the defenders: able-bodied men would mount the ramparts, women would carry stones.
translations.idiomatic: Guohong discussed with the defenders: able-bodied men would mount the ramparts while women carried stones.

sentences.zh: 楊先倡，城中女子從之，須臾四城皆遍。

translations.literal: Yang took the lead; women throughout the city followed her, and in no time all four walls were covered.
translations.idiomatic: Yang took the lead, and women throughout the city followed. In no time all four walls were covered.

sentences.zh: 及城陷，楊死譙樓旁。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Yang died beside the watchtower.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Yang died beside the watchtower.

sentences.zh: 事定，家人獲其屍，兩手猶抱石不脫。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled her family recovered her corpse; both hands still clutched stones and would not release them.
translations.idiomatic: When affairs were settled her family recovered her corpse. Both hands still clutched stones and would not let go.

sentences.zh: 仲氏女，湖州人，隨父賈漢陽。

translations.literal: The daughter of the Zhong clan, a native of Huzhou, followed her father trading in Hanyang.
translations.idiomatic: The daughter of the Zhong clan, from Huzhou, followed her father trading in Hanyang.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，漢陽陷，從群婦將出城，賊守門者止之。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen, when Hanyang fell she was about to leave the city with a crowd of women, but bandits guarding the gate stopped them.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign, when Hanyang fell she was about to leave the city with a crowd of women, but bandits guarding the gate stopped them.

sentences.zh: 有頃，賊大肆淫掠，見女美，執之。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits carried out widespread rape and plunder; seeing the girl's beauty they seized her.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandits carried out widespread rape and plunder. Seeing the girl's beauty, they seized her.

sentences.zh: 女剺面披發，大罵。

translations.literal: The girl slashed her face and let her hair hang loose, cursing loudly.
translations.idiomatic: The girl slashed her face, let her hair hang loose, and cursed loudly.

sentences.zh: 賊具馬，命二賊挾之上，連墜傷額，終不肯往。

translations.literal: The bandits prepared a horse and ordered two bandits to lift her onto it; she fell repeatedly and injured her forehead, yet in the end would not go.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits prepared a horse and ordered two bandits to lift her onto it. She fell repeatedly and injured her forehead, yet in the end she would not go.

sentences.zh: 賊露刃迫之曰：「身往何如頭往？

translations.literal: The bandits bared their blades and pressed her, saying, "Will you go in person, or shall your head go?
translations.idiomatic: The bandits bared their blades and pressed her, saying, "Will you go in person, or shall your head go?

sentences.zh: 」笑曰：「頭往善。

translations.literal: " She smiled and said, "For the head to go is best.
translations.idiomatic: " She smiled and said, "For the head to go is best.

sentences.zh: 」遂被害。

translations.literal: " She was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: " She was then killed.

sentences.zh: 鄺抱義妻何氏。

translations.literal: He, wife of Kuang Baoyi.
translations.idiomatic: Lady He, wife of Kuang Baoyi.

sentences.zh: 抱義，臨武諸生。

translations.literal: Baoyi was a student of Linwu.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyi was a licentiate of Linwu.

sentences.zh: 崇禎末，氏為賊所執，乃垢面蓬發紿以病疫，賊懼釋之。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongzhen the lady was seized by bandits; she smeared her face filthy and let her hair hang in disarray, pretending to have plague, and the bandits in fear released her.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Chongzhen reign she was seized by bandits. She smeared her face filthy, let her hair hang in disarray, and pretended to have plague. The bandits released her in fear.

sentences.zh: 及賊退，家人鹹喜，何泣曰：「平昔謁拜伯叔，猶赭顏汗發。

translations.literal: When the bandits withdrew her family were all glad, but He wept and said, "In ordinary times when I called on uncles and elders I still blushed and broke into a sweat.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits withdrew her family rejoiced, but He wept and said, "In ordinary times when I called on uncles and elders I still blushed and broke into a sweat.

sentences.zh: 今匿身不固，以面目對賊，牽臂引裾，雖免汙辱，何以為人！

translations.literal: Now my concealment was not secure; I showed my face to bandits who seized my arms and pulled my skirts—though I escaped defilement, how can I face the world!
translations.idiomatic: Now my concealment was not secure. I showed my face to bandits who seized my arms and pulled my skirts. Though I escaped defilement, how can I face the world!

sentences.zh: 」竟忿恚不食死。

translations.literal: " In the end she died from indignant fasting.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end she died from indignant fasting.

sentences.zh: 湯祖契妻趙氏。

translations.literal: Zhao, wife of Tang Zuqi.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhao, wife of Tang Zuqi.

sentences.zh: 祖契，睢州諸生。

translations.literal: Zuqi was a licentiate of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zuqi was a licentiate of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 氏知書，有誌節。

translations.literal: The lady was literate and possessed resolve and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: She was literate and possessed firm resolve and integrity.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十五年，賊陷太康，將抵睢。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Chongzhen, bandits captured Taikang and were about to reach Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Chongzhen reign, bandits captured Taikang and were about to reach Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 氏語家人曰：「州為兵沖，未易保也。

translations.literal: The lady told her household, "The prefecture lies on a military thoroughfare and will not be easy to hold.
translations.idiomatic: The lady told her household, "The prefecture lies on a military thoroughfare and will not be easy to hold.

sentences.zh: 脫變起，有死耳。

translations.literal: If trouble should arise, there is only death.
translations.idiomatic: If trouble should arise, there is only death.

sentences.zh: 」及城破，屬祖契負其母以逃，而己闔戶自經，家人解之，投井，復為家人所阻，怒曰：「賊至不死，非節也，死不以時，非義也。

translations.literal: " When the city fell she entrusted Zuqi to carry his mother and flee, while she herself closed the doors and hanged herself; her family cut her down; she threw herself into a well and was again stopped by her family; she said angrily, "Not to die when bandits arrive is not chastity; to die not at the proper time is not righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: " When the city fell she entrusted Zuqi to carry his mother and flee, while she herself closed the doors and hanged herself. Her family cut her down. She threw herself into a well and was again stopped by her family. She said angrily, "Not to die when bandits arrive is not chastity; to die not at the proper time is not righteousness.

sentences.zh: 」賊至，環刃相向，牽之出，厲聲訶賊，遂遇害。

translations.literal: " When the bandits arrived they surrounded her with blades, dragged her out, and she shouted at the bandits in a fierce voice; she was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: " When the bandits arrived they surrounded her with blades and dragged her out. She shouted at the bandits in a fierce voice and was then killed.

sentences.zh: 蕭來鳳妻倪氏。

translations.literal: Lady Ni, wife of Xiao Laifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Ni, wife of Xiao Laifeng.

sentences.zh: 來鳳，商城貢生，慷慨有大節。

translations.literal: Laifeng was a tribute student of Shangcheng, generous and possessed of great integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Laifeng was a tribute student of Shangcheng, generous and possessed of great integrity.

sentences.zh: 賊逼受職，不屈死，倪自經從之。

translations.literal: The bandits pressed him to accept an appointment; he refused and died; Ni hanged herself to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits pressed him to accept an appointment. He refused and died. Ni hanged herself to follow him.

sentences.zh: 又有宋愈亨，深澤舉人，寇至投井死。

translations.literal: There was also Song Yuheng, a provincial graduate of Shenze; when bandits arrived he threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Song Yuheng, a provincial graduate of Shenze. When bandits arrived he threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 妻王氏曰：「夫既如此，吾敢相負。

translations.literal: His wife Lady Wang said, "Since my husband has done this, how dare I fail him.
translations.idiomatic: His wife Lady Wang said, "Since my husband has done this, how dare I fail him.

sentences.zh: 」媳韓生男甫六日，願從死，相對縊。

translations.literal: " The daughter-in-law Han had given birth to a son only six days before; she wished to die with them and they hanged themselves facing one another.
translations.idiomatic: " The daughter-in-law Han had given birth to a son only six days before. She wished to die with them, and they hanged themselves facing one another.

sentences.zh: 邵氏，鄒縣張一桂妻，同妾李氏遇賊。

translations.literal: Lady Shao, wife of Zhang Yigui of Zou County, together with the concubine Lady Li encountered bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Shao, wife of Zhang Yigui of Zou County, together with the concubine Lady Li encountered bandits.

sentences.zh: 欲迫李行，邵罵曰：「亡夫以妾托我，豈令受賊辱。

translations.literal: The bandits wished to force Li to go with them; Shao cursed them, saying, "My late husband entrusted the concubine to me—how could I let her suffer bandit insult.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits wished to force Li to go with them. Shao cursed them, saying, "My late husband entrusted the concubine to me—how could I let her suffer bandit insult.

sentences.zh: 」賊怒殺之。

translations.literal: " The bandits in anger killed her.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits in anger killed her.

sentences.zh: 李知不免，紿曰：「我有簪珥埋後園井旁。

translations.literal: Li knew she could not escape and deceived them, saying, "I have hairpins and earrings buried beside the well in the rear garden.
translations.idiomatic: Li knew she could not escape and deceived them, saying, "I have hairpins and earrings buried beside the well in the rear garden.

sentences.zh: 」賊隨李發之，至則曰：「主母為我死，我豈獨生。

translations.literal: " The bandits followed Li to dig them up; when they arrived she said, "The mistress died for me—how could I live alone.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits followed Li to dig them up. When they arrived she said, "The mistress died for me—how could I live alone.

sentences.zh: 」即投井。

translations.literal: " She immediately threw herself into the well.
translations.idiomatic: " She immediately threw herself into the well.

sentences.zh: 賊下井扶之，李披發破面罵不已，扭其衣欲令並死井底，叫聲若雷。

translations.literal: The bandits went down the well to pull her out; Li let her hair hang loose and slashed her face, cursing without cease; she twisted their clothes wishing to make them die together at the bottom of the well, her cries like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits went down the well to pull her out. Li let her hair hang loose and slashed her face, cursing without cease. She twisted their clothes wishing to make them die together at the bottom of the well, her cries like thunder.

sentences.zh: 賊知不可強，乃刃之。

translations.literal: The bandits knew she could not be forced and then bladed her.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits knew she could not be forced and then killed her with blades.

sentences.zh: 宗胤芳妻江氏，魯山人。

translations.literal: Lady Jiang, wife of Zong Yinfang, a native of Lushan.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Jiang, wife of Zong Yinfang, a native of Lushan.

sentences.zh: 子麟祥，進士。

translations.literal: Their son Lixiang became a jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: Their son Lixiang became a jinshi.

sentences.zh: 流賊之亂，江與麟祥妻袁氏率孫女、孫婦九人登樓，俱懸於梁。

translations.literal: During the turmoil of roving bandits, Jiang together with Lixiang's wife Lady Yuan led granddaughters and granddaughters-in-law, nine persons in all, up a tower and all hanged themselves from the beam.
translations.idiomatic: During the turmoil of roving bandits, Jiang together with Lixiang's wife Lady Yuan led granddaughters and granddaughters-in-law—nine persons in all—up a tower, and all hanged themselves from the beam.

sentences.zh: 視其已死，乃引刀自剄。

translations.literal: Seeing that they were dead, she then drew a knife and cut her own throat.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing that they were dead, she then drew a knife and cut her own throat.

sentences.zh: 曹復彬妻楊氏。

translations.literal: Lady Yang, wife of Cao Fubin.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yang, wife of Cao Fubin.

sentences.zh: 復彬，江都諸生。

translations.literal: Fubin was a licentiate of Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Fubin was a licentiate of Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 城破，復彬創仆地，楊匿破屋中。

translations.literal: When the city fell Fubin was wounded and fell to the ground; Yang hid in a ruined house.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell Fubin was wounded and fell to the ground. Yang hid in a ruined house.

sentences.zh: 長女蒨文，年十四，趣母決計。

translations.literal: The elder daughter Qianwen, age fourteen, urged her mother to decide on a course.
translations.idiomatic: The elder daughter Qianwen, age fourteen, urged her mother to decide on a course.

sentences.zh: 次女蒨紅，年十二，請更衣死。

translations.literal: The younger daughter Qianhong, age twelve, asked to change her clothes before dying.
translations.idiomatic: The younger daughter Qianhong, age twelve, asked to change her clothes before dying.

sentences.zh: 楊止之，復彬執不可，乃為三繯，次第而縊。

translations.literal: Yang stopped her; Fubin insisted it could not be done; they then made three nooses and hanged themselves in order.
translations.idiomatic: Yang stopped her, but Fubin insisted it could not be done. They then made three nooses and hanged themselves in order.

sentences.zh: 梁以樟妻張氏，大興人。

translations.literal: Lady Zhang, wife of Liang Yizhang, a native of Daxing.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhang, wife of Liang Yizhang, a native of Daxing.

sentences.zh: 以樟知商丘縣。

translations.literal: Yizhang was magistrate of Shangqiu County.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhang was magistrate of Shangqiu County.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十五年，流賊圍商丘，急積薪樓下，集婢女其上，俱令就縊。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Chongzhen roving bandits besieged Shangqiu; she urgently piled firewood below the tower, gathered maidservants upon it, and had them all hang themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Chongzhen reign roving bandits besieged Shangqiu. She urgently piled firewood below the tower, gathered maidservants upon it, and had them all hang themselves.

sentences.zh: 謂子燮曰：「汝父城守，命不可知，宗祀惟汝是賴。

translations.literal: She said to her son Xie, "Your father is holding the city; his fate is unknown; the ancestral sacrifices depend on you alone.
translations.idiomatic: She said to her son Xie, "Your father is holding the city; his fate is unknown. The ancestral sacrifices depend on you alone.

sentences.zh: 」屬乳媼匿民家。

translations.literal: " She entrusted him to a wet nurse to hide among the common people.
translations.idiomatic: " She entrusted him to a wet nurse to hide among the common people.

sentences.zh: 自縊死。

translations.literal: She hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: She hanged herself and died.

sentences.zh: 家人舉火，諸屍俱燼。

translations.literal: Her family set a fire and all the corpses were reduced to ash.
translations.idiomatic: Her family set a fire and all the corpses were reduced to ash.

sentences.zh: 鄭完我母石氏，甘州衛人。

translations.literal: Lady Shi, mother of Zheng Wanwo, a native of Ganzhou Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Shi, mother of Zheng Wanwo, a native of Ganzhou Guard.

sentences.zh: 完我，南陽府同知，既之官，妻王氏奉石家居。

translations.literal: Wanwo was assistant prefect of Nanyang Prefecture; having taken office, his wife Lady Wang attended Lady Shi at home.
translations.idiomatic: Wanwo was assistant prefect of Nanyang Prefecture. Having taken office, his wife Lady Wang attended Lady Shi at home.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十六年，賊圍甘州，石預戒家人積薪室中。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chongzhen bandits besieged Ganzhou; Shi beforehand warned the household to pile firewood in the rooms.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of the Chongzhen reign bandits besieged Ganzhou. Shi beforehand warned the household to pile firewood in the rooms.

sentences.zh: 及城陷，攜王及一孫女縱火自焚。

translations.literal: When the city fell she took Wang and one granddaughter and set fire on themselves.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell she took Wang and one granddaughter and burned themselves to death.

sentences.zh: 寇退，出屍灰燼間，姑媳牽挽不釋手。

translations.literal: When the bandits withdrew, from among the ash of the corpses mother-in-law and daughter-in-law were found clutching one another and would not let go.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits withdrew, from among the ash of the corpses the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law were found clutching one another and would not let go.

sentences.zh: 女距三尺許，覆以甕，啟視色如生。

translations.literal: The girl lay about three feet away, covered with a jar; when they opened it her complexion was as in life.
translations.idiomatic: The girl lay about three feet away, covered with a jar. When they opened it her complexion was as in life.

sentences.zh: 郭氏，長治宋體道妻。

translations.literal: Lady Guo, wife of Song Tidao of Changzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Guo, wife of Song Tidao of Changzhi.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十五年，任國琦作亂，同居諸婦皆羅跪，呼郭不出，獨匿垝垣。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Chongzhen Ren Guoqi raised a revolt; all the women living together knelt in a row calling for Guo to come out, but she alone hid behind a collapsed wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Chongzhen reign Ren Guoqi raised a revolt. All the women living together knelt in a row calling for Guo to come out, but she alone hid behind a collapsed wall.

sentences.zh: 賊怒，詰其不跪，瞪目厲聲曰：「我跪亦死，不跪亦死，已安排不活矣。

translations.literal: The bandits in anger questioned why she would not kneel; she stared with bulging eyes and said in a fierce voice, "If I kneel I die, if I do not kneel I die—I have already arranged not to live.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits in anger questioned why she would not kneel. She stared with bulging eyes and said in a fierce voice, "If I kneel I die; if I do not kneel I die—I have already arranged not to live.

sentences.zh: 」賊加數刃，迄死罵不絕口。

translations.literal: " The bandits struck her many times with blades; until death she cursed without cease.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits struck her many times with blades. Until death she cursed without cease.

sentences.zh: 姚氏，桐城人，湘潭知縣之騏女，諸生吳道震妻。

translations.literal: Lady Yao, a native of Tongcheng, daughter of Magistrate Zhiqi of Xiangtan, wife of the licentiate Wu Daozhen.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yao, a native of Tongcheng, daughter of Magistrate Zhiqi of Xiangtan, wife of the licentiate Wu Daozhen.

sentences.zh: 年十九，夫亡，以子德堅在繈褓，忍死撫之。

translations.literal: At age nineteen her husband died; because her son Dejian was in swaddling clothes she endured death to nurture him.
translations.idiomatic: At age nineteen her husband died. Because her son Dejian was still in swaddling clothes she endured death to nurture him.

sentences.zh: 越二十六年，至崇禎末，流賊掠桐城。

translations.literal: After twenty-six years, reaching the end of Chongzhen, roving bandits plundered Tongcheng.
translations.idiomatic: After twenty-six years, reaching the end of the Chongzhen reign, roving bandits plundered Tongcheng.

sentences.zh: 兄孫林奉母避潛山，氏偕行。

translations.literal: Her elder brother's grandson Lin escorted their mother to avoid danger at Qianshan; the lady went along.
translations.idiomatic: Her elder brother's grandson Lin escorted their mother to avoid danger at Qianshan. The lady went along.

sentences.zh: 賊奄至，孫林格鬥死，德堅負氏逃。

translations.literal: Bandits suddenly arrived; Sun Lin died fighting; Dejian carried the lady fleeing.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits suddenly arrived. Sun Lin died fighting. Dejian carried the lady fleeing.

sentences.zh: 氏曰：「事急矣，汝書生焉能負我遠行，倘賊追及，即俱死，汝不能全母，顧反絕父祀乎！

translations.literal: The lady said, "The matter is urgent; you are a student—how can you carry me on a distant flight? If bandits should overtake us we will both die; you cannot save your mother yet would cut off your father's sacrifices!
translations.idiomatic: The lady said, "The matter is urgent. You are a student—how can you carry me on a distant flight? If bandits should overtake us we will both die. You cannot save your mother yet would cut off your father's sacrifices!

sentences.zh: 」叱之去，德堅泣弗忍，氏推之墜層崖下。

translations.literal: " She scolded him to go; Dejian wept and could not bear to; she pushed him and he fell from a layered cliff.
translations.idiomatic: " She scolded him to go. Dejian wept and could not bear to leave. She pushed him and he fell from a layered cliff.

sentences.zh: 須臾賊至，叱曰：「出金可免。

translations.literal: In a moment bandits arrived and shouted, "Produce gold and you may be spared.
translations.idiomatic: In a moment bandits arrived and shouted, "Produce gold and you may be spared.

sentences.zh: 」氏曰：「我流離遠道，安得有金。

translations.literal: " The lady said, "I am a refugee on a distant road—how could I have gold.
translations.idiomatic: " The lady said, "I am a refugee on a distant road—how could I have gold.

sentences.zh: 」賊令解衣驗之，罵曰：「何物賊奴，敢作此語！

translations.literal: " The bandits ordered her to strip for verification and cursed, "What kind of bandit slave dares speak thus!
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits ordered her to strip for verification and cursed, "What kind of bandit slave dares speak thus!

sentences.zh: 」賊怒，刃交下死。

translations.literal: " The bandits in anger struck her to death with crossing blades.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits in anger struck her to death with crossing blades.

sentences.zh: 朱氏，無為人，徐畢璋妻。

translations.literal: Lady Zhu, a native of Wuwei, wife of Xu Bizhang.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhu, a native of Wuwei, wife of Xu Bizhang.

sentences.zh: 年十七，歸璋。

translations.literal: At age seventeen she married Bizhang.
translations.idiomatic: At age seventeen she married Bizhang.

sentences.zh: 璋有妹名京，年十五，未字。

translations.literal: Bizhang had a younger sister named Jing, age fifteen, not yet betrothed.
translations.idiomatic: Bizhang had a younger sister named Jing, age fifteen, not yet betrothed.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十五年，流賊破城。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Chongzhen roving bandits breached the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the Chongzhen reign roving bandits breached the city.

sentences.zh: 朱方懷孕，奔井邊，謂京曰：「吾妊在懷，井口狹，可推而納之。

translations.literal: Zhu was pregnant and ran to the edge of a well; she said to Jing, "I am pregnant; the mouth of the well is narrow—you can push me in.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu was pregnant and ran to the edge of a well. She said to Jing, "I am pregnant. The mouth of the well is narrow—you can push me in.

sentences.zh: 」京曰：「唯。

translations.literal: " Jing said, "Yes.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing said, "Yes.

sentences.zh: 」納畢，即哭呼曰：「父母安在乎，吾伴嫂死矣！

translations.literal: " When Zhu was in she immediately cried out, "Where are Father and Mother? I accompany my sister-in-law in death!
translations.idiomatic: " When Zhu was in she immediately cried out, "Where are Father and Mother? I accompany my sister-in-law in death!

sentences.zh: 」躍而入。

translations.literal: " She leaped in after her.
translations.idiomatic: " She leaped in after her.

sentences.zh: 李氏，定州人，廣平教授元薦女，歸同里郝生。

translations.literal: Lady Li, a native of Dingzhou, daughter of Instructor Yuanyuan of Guangping, married a man named Hao of the same district.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Li, a native of Dingzhou, daughter of Instructor Yuanyuan of Guangping, married a man named Hao of the same district.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十六年，州被兵。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chongzhen the prefecture suffered warfare.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of the Chongzhen reign the prefecture suffered warfare.

sentences.zh: 生將奉親避山中，留李與二子居其母家。

translations.literal: Hao was about to escort his parents to avoid danger in the mountains and left Li with two sons staying at his mother's home.
translations.idiomatic: Hao was about to escort his parents to avoid danger in the mountains and left Li with two sons staying at his mother's home.

sentences.zh: 生控馬將發，李哭拜馬前，指庭中井訣曰：「若有變，即潔身此中，以衣袂為識，旁有白線一行者，即我也。

translations.literal: As Hao took the reins and was about to depart Li wept and bowed before the horse, pointing to the courtyard well in farewell and saying, "If there should be trouble, then purify your body in this place; take the sleeve of my robe as a token—where there is a row of white thread beside it, that is me.
translations.idiomatic: As Hao took the reins and was about to depart, Li wept and bowed before the horse. She pointed to the courtyard well in farewell and said, "If there should be trouble, purify your body in this place. Take the sleeve of my robe as a token—where there is a row of white thread beside it, that is me.

sentences.zh: 」比城破，藏二子他所，入井死。

translations.literal: " When the city fell she hid the two sons elsewhere and entered the well and died.
translations.idiomatic: " When the city fell she hid the two sons elsewhere, entered the well, and died.

sentences.zh: 兵退，生出其屍，顏色如生。

translations.literal: When the soldiers withdrew Hao took out her corpse; her complexion was as in life.
translations.idiomatic: When the soldiers withdrew Hao took out her corpse. Her complexion was as in life.

sentences.zh: 胡敬妻姚氏。

translations.literal: Lady Yao, wife of Hu Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Yao, wife of Hu Jing.

sentences.zh: 敬，孝感貢生。

translations.literal: Jing was a tribute student of Xiaogan.
translations.idiomatic: Jing was a tribute student of Xiaogan.

sentences.zh: 流賊陷孝感，姚乘舟避難南湖，欷歔不已。

translations.literal: When roving bandits took Xiaogan Yao boarded a boat to flee to South Lake, sighing and sobbing without cease.
translations.idiomatic: When roving bandits took Xiaogan, Yao boarded a boat to flee to South Lake, sighing and sobbing without cease.

sentences.zh: 鄰舟婦解之曰：「賊入黃，從未殺人，何畏也？

translations.literal: A woman on a neighboring boat consoled her, saying, "When bandits enter Huangzhou they have never killed anyone—why fear?
translations.idiomatic: A woman on a neighboring boat consoled her, saying, "When bandits enter Huangzhou they have never killed anyone—why fear?

sentences.zh: 」姚曰：「我非畏殺，畏其不殺耳。

translations.literal: " Yao said, "It is not death I fear—I fear that they will not kill me.
translations.idiomatic: " Yao said, "It is not death I fear—I fear that they will not kill me.

sentences.zh: 」聞賊將入湖，嘆曰：「賊至而死，辱矣。

translations.literal: " Hearing that bandits were about to enter the lake she sighed, "To die when bandits arrive would be shameful.
translations.idiomatic: " Hearing that bandits were about to enter the lake she sighed, "To die when bandits arrive would be shameful.

sentences.zh: 」遂攜二女僮投水死。

translations.literal: " She then took two young maidservants and threw herself into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: " She then took two young maidservants and threw herself into the water and died.

sentences.zh: 熊氏，武昌李藎臣妻，大名知縣正南女。

translations.literal: Lady Xiong, wife of Li Jinchen of Wuchang, daughter of Magistrate Zhengnan of Daming.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Xiong, wife of Li Jinchen of Wuchang, daughter of Magistrate Zhengnan of Daming.

sentences.zh: 藎臣父周華，官贛州知官，藎臣從父之任，留婦於家。

translations.literal: Jinchen's father Zhouhua was prefect of Ganzhou; Jinchen followed his father to his post and left his wife at home.
translations.idiomatic: Jinchen's father Zhouhua was prefect of Ganzhou. Jinchen followed his father to his post and left his wife at home.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十六年，武昌陷，婦匿林藪中，為賊所得，奪刀自刎。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chongzhen Wuchang fell; the wife hid in woods and thickets but was taken by bandits and snatched a blade to cut her own throat.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of the Chongzhen reign Wuchang fell. The wife hid in woods and thickets but was taken by bandits and snatched a blade to cut her own throat.

sentences.zh: 賊去，鄰嫗救活之。

translations.literal: When the bandits left a neighboring old woman revived her.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits left, a neighboring old woman revived her.

sentences.zh: 明年，李自成率殘卒南奔，婦只身竄山谷。

translations.literal: The next year Li Zicheng led his remnant troops fleeing south; the wife alone fled into mountain valleys.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Li Zicheng led his remnant troops fleeing south. The wife alone fled into mountain valleys.

sentences.zh: 有胡姓者，欲為子娶之。

translations.literal: A man surnamed Hu wished to marry her to his son.
translations.idiomatic: A man surnamed Hu wished to marry her to his son.

sentences.zh: 婦曰：「吾頸可斷，汝不聞前事乎！

translations.literal: The wife said, "My neck can be severed—have you not heard what happened before!
translations.idiomatic: The wife said, "My neck can be severed—have you not heard what happened before!

sentences.zh: 」已，藎臣自江西歸，遇賊被殺。

translations.literal: " Later Jinchen returned from Jiangxi and encountered bandits and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: " Later Jinchen returned from Jiangxi, encountered bandits, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 婦慟三日，自縊死。

translations.literal: The wife mourned three days and hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: The wife mourned three days and hanged herself and died.

sentences.zh: 丘氏，孝感劉應景妻。

translations.literal: Lady Qiu, wife of Liu Yingjing of Xiaogan.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Qiu, wife of Liu Yingjing of Xiaogan.

sentences.zh: 崇禎末，為賊所執，逼從，不可。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongzhen she was seized by bandits; they pressed her to follow them but she would not.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Chongzhen reign she was seized by bandits. They pressed her to follow them but she would not.

sentences.zh: 賊曰：「刃汝。

translations.literal: The bandits said, "I will blade you.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits said, "I will blade you.

sentences.zh: 」丘曰：「得死為幸。

translations.literal: " Qiu said, "To obtain death is fortunate.
translations.idiomatic: " Qiu said, "To obtain death is fortunate.

sentences.zh: 」賊註油滿甕，漬其衣，語同類曰：「此婦倔強，將巘之。

translations.literal: " The bandits poured oil filling a jar, soaked her clothes, and said to their fellows, "This woman is stubborn; we will burn her alive.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits poured oil filling a jar, soaked her clothes, and said to their fellows, "This woman is stubborn; we will burn her alive.

sentences.zh: 」丘哂曰：「若謂死溺、死焚、死刃有間乎？

translations.literal: " Qiu sneered, "Do you suppose dying by drowning, dying by burning, and dying by the blade differ?
translations.idiomatic: " Qiu sneered, "Do you suppose dying by drowning, dying by burning, and dying by the blade differ?

sentences.zh: 官兵旦夕至，若求如我，得哉！

translations.literal: Government troops will arrive any day or night—if you seek death like mine, can you obtain it!
translations.idiomatic: Government troops will arrive any day or night—if you seek death like mine, can you obtain it!

sentences.zh: 」賊怒，束於木焚之，火熾，罵不絕口。

translations.literal: " The bandits in anger bound her to wood and burned her; as the fire blazed she cursed without cease.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits in anger bound her to wood and burned her. As the fire blazed she cursed without cease.

sentences.zh: 同邑乾氏，年十七，歸高文煥。

translations.literal: A woman of the Gan clan of the same district, age seventeen, married Gao Wenhuan.
translations.idiomatic: A woman of the Gan clan of the same district, age seventeen, married Gao Wenhuan.

sentences.zh: 文煥卒，無子，拔刀自裁。

translations.literal: When Wenhuan died and there was no son she drew a blade and cut herself.
translations.idiomatic: When Wenhuan died and there was no son, she drew a blade and cut herself.

sentences.zh: 母及姑救之，越三日復蘇。

translations.literal: Her mother and mother-in-law saved her; after three days she revived again.
translations.idiomatic: Her mother and mother-in-law saved her. After three days she revived again.

sentences.zh: 自是斷葷，日不再食。

translations.literal: From then on she abstained from meat and ate only once a day.
translations.idiomatic: From then on she abstained from meat and ate only once a day.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十六年，聞賊陷德安，將及孝感。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chongzhen, she heard that bandits had captured De'an and were about to reach Xiaogan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year of the Chongzhen reign, she heard that bandits had captured De'an and were about to reach Xiaogan.

sentences.zh: 從子高騫將扶避山砦，氏曰：「吾老矣，豈復出門求活。

translations.literal: Her nephew Gao Qian was about to support her and flee to a mountain stockade; the lady said, "I am old—how could I go out again seeking life.
translations.idiomatic: Her nephew Gao Qian was about to help her flee to a mountain stockade. The lady said, "I am old. How could I go out again merely to save my life?

sentences.zh: 行吾四十年前之誌，可也。

translations.literal: Fulfill my resolve of forty years ago—that will do.
translations.idiomatic: Carry out the resolve I made forty years ago—that will suffice.

sentences.zh: 」投後園池中死。

translations.literal: " She threw herself into the rear garden pool and died.
translations.idiomatic: " She threw herself into the rear garden pool and died.

sentences.zh: 邑又有黃氏，張挺然妻。

translations.literal: In the district there was also Lady Huang, wife of Zhang Tingran.
translations.idiomatic: In the district there was also Lady Huang, wife of Zhang Tingran.

sentences.zh: 崇禎末，賊帥白旺陷德安，授挺然偽掌旅。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongzhen, the bandit chieftain Bai Wang captured De'an and appointed Tingran fake brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Chongzhen reign, the bandit chieftain Bai Wang captured De'an and appointed Tingran a bogus brigade commander under the rebel regime.

sentences.zh: 黃泣止之，不聽。

translations.literal: Huang wept and stopped him; he would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Huang wept and tried to stop him, but he would not listen.

sentences.zh: 賊令挺然取婦為質，黃攜十歲兒匿青山砦。

translations.literal: The bandits ordered Tingran to take his wife as hostage; Huang took her ten-year-old son and hid in Qingshan stockade.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits ordered Tingran to take his wife as a hostage. Huang took her ten-year-old son and hid in the Qingshan stockade.

sentences.zh: 挺然誘以利，劫以兵，且使親戚招之，皆不應。

translations.literal: Tingran lured with profit and threatened with arms, and even had relatives summon her—all without response.
translations.idiomatic: Tingran tried to lure her with rewards and coerce her with troops, and even had relatives call on her—she would not respond.

sentences.zh: 已而破砦，焚己居以窮黃，黃匿愈深，竟不可得。

translations.literal: Before long they broke the stockade, burned his own dwelling to corner Huang; Huang hid deeper and in the end could not be found.
translations.idiomatic: Before long they stormed the stockade and burned his own home to drive Huang out. She hid deeper still and in the end could not be found.

sentences.zh: 挺然寄兒金簪，兒以綰發，黃怒，拔棄之曰：「何為以賊物汙首！

translations.literal: Tingran sent the child a gold hairpin; the child used it to tie his hair; Huang in anger pulled it out and discarded it, saying, "Why use rebel goods to defile one's head!
translations.idiomatic: Tingran sent the boy a gold hairpin; the boy used it to bind his hair. Huang angrily pulled it out and threw it away, saying, "Why defile your head with rebel goods!

sentences.zh: 」久之，賊敗，挺然走死襄陽，黃耕織以撫其子，鄉人義之。

translations.literal: " After a long time the bandits were defeated; Tingran fled and died in Xiangyang; Huang farmed and wove to raise her son; the villagers praised her righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: " After a long time the bandits were defeated. Tingran fled and died in Xiangyang. Huang farmed and wove to support her son, and the villagers honored her conduct.

sentences.zh: 蘄水洗馬畈某氏，為賊所執，不從。

translations.literal: A woman of a certain clan at Ximafan in Qishui was seized by bandits and would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: A woman of a certain clan at Ximafan in Qishui was seized by bandits and would not submit.

sentences.zh: 賊刃其腹，一手抱嬰兒，一手捧腹，使氣不即盡以待夫。

translations.literal: The bandits bladed her belly; with one hand she held her infant and with one hand cupped her belly, so her breath would not immediately exhaust while awaiting her husband.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits slashed her belly. With one hand she held her infant and with the other she pressed her wound, keeping herself alive until her husband could arrive.

sentences.zh: 夫至，付兒，放手而斃。

translations.literal: When her husband arrived she handed over the child, released her hands, and died.
translations.idiomatic: When her husband arrived she handed him the child, let go, and died.

sentences.zh: 向氏，黃陂人。

translations.literal: Lady Xiang, a native of Huangpi.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Xiang, a native of Huangpi.

sentences.zh: 年十八，歸王旦士。

translations.literal: At eighteen she married Wang Danshi.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen she married Wang Danshi.

sentences.zh: 未久，賊陷黃陂，被執。

translations.literal: Before long bandits captured Huangpi and she was seized.
translations.idiomatic: Before long bandits captured Huangpi and she was seized.

sentences.zh: 賊持刀迫之，氏罵不絕口。

translations.literal: The bandits held blades and pressed her; the lady cursed without cease.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits held blades to her throat; the lady cursed without cease.

sentences.zh: 賊指眾曰：「若非汝父母，即舅姑兄弟，必盡殺，而後及汝。

translations.literal: The bandits pointed at the crowd and said, "If not your parents, then your parents-in-law and brothers—we will kill them all, and afterward reach you.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits pointed at the crowd and said, "If they are not your parents, then they are your parents-in-law and brothers—we will kill them all, and only then come for you.

sentences.zh: 」氏曰：「我義不辱，與家人何與！

translations.literal: " The lady said, "I by righteousness will not be disgraced—what has that to do with my family!
translations.idiomatic: " The lady said, "I would rather die than be dishonored—what does that have to do with my family!

sentences.zh: 」奪刃自刎。

translations.literal: " She seized a blade and cut her own throat.
translations.idiomatic: " She seized a blade and cut her own throat.

sentences.zh: 賊怒，立磔之。

translations.literal: The bandits in anger immediately dismembered her on a stake.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits in anger immediately dismembered her on a stake.

sentences.zh: 劉長庚妾雷氏。

translations.literal: Lady Lei, concubine of Liu Changgeng.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Lei, concubine of Liu Changgeng.

sentences.zh: 長庚為同州諸生。

translations.literal: Changgeng was a licentiate of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Changgeng was a licentiate of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊陷潼關，將及州，長庚拜家廟，召妻及二子曰：「汝年長，且有子，當逃。

translations.literal: Bandits captured Tong Pass and were about to reach the prefecture; Changgeng bowed at the family shrine, summoned his wife and two sons, and said, "You are older and moreover have sons—you should flee.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits captured Tong Pass and were about to reach the prefecture. Changgeng bowed at the family shrine, summoned his wife and two sons, and said, "You are older and already have sons of your own—you should flee.

sentences.zh: 」召雷及所生女曰：「汝年少，當從吾死。

translations.literal: " He summoned Lei and his biological daughter and said, "You are young—you should follow me in death.
translations.idiomatic: " He summoned Lei and his own daughter and said, "You are young—you should die with me.

sentences.zh: 」雷曰：「妾誌也。

translations.literal: " Lei said, "That is this concubine's resolve.
translations.idiomatic: " Lei said, "That has always been this concubine's resolve.

sentences.zh: 」長庚攜酒登樓，謂妾曰：「汝平日不飲，今當共醉。

translations.literal: " Changgeng brought wine and ascended a tower, telling his concubine, "You ordinarily do not drink—today we should get drunk together.
translations.idiomatic: " Changgeng brought wine and went up to a tower, telling his concubine, "You never drink, but today we shall drink our fill together.

sentences.zh: 」妾欣然引滿。

translations.literal: " The concubine gladly drained her cup.
translations.idiomatic: " The concubine gladly drained her cup.

sentences.zh: 長庚且飲且歌，夜半遍題四壁，拔刀示妾曰：「可以行乎？

translations.literal: Changgeng drank and sang; at midnight he inscribed all four walls, drew his blade and showed his concubine, saying, "May we proceed?
translations.idiomatic: Changgeng drank and sang. At midnight he covered all four walls with inscriptions, drew his blade, and showed it to his concubine, saying, "Shall we go ahead?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「請先之。

translations.literal: " She replied, "Please go first.
translations.idiomatic: " She replied, "Please go first.

sentences.zh: 」奪刀自刎。

translations.literal: " She seized the blade and cut her own throat.
translations.idiomatic: " She seized the blade and cut her own throat.

sentences.zh: 長庚乃解所系條，縊於梁。

translations.literal: Changgeng then untied the cord at his waist and hanged himself from a beam.
translations.idiomatic: Changgeng then untied the cord at his waist and hanged himself from a beam.

sentences.zh: 女方七歲，橫刀於壁，以頸就之而死。

translations.literal: The girl was seven; she laid a blade across the wall and pressed her neck to it and died.
translations.idiomatic: The girl was seven. She laid a blade against the wall and pressed her neck to it until she died.

sentences.zh: 邵氏，商州人，布政使可立女，侍郎雒南薛國用子匡倫妻也。

translations.literal: Lady Shao, a native of Shangzhou, daughter of Surveillance Commissioner Ke Li, wife of Kuang Lun son of Vice Minister Xue Guoyong of Luonan.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Shao, a native of Shangzhou, daughter of Surveillance Commissioner Ke Li and wife of Kuang Lun, son of Vice Minister Xue Guoyong of Luonan.

sentences.zh: 流賊將至，避之母家。

translations.literal: As roving bandits were about to arrive she took refuge at her mother's family.
translations.idiomatic: As roving bandits were about to arrive, she took refuge at her mother's home.

sentences.zh: 商州陷，賊驅使執爨，罵曰：「吾大家女，嫁大臣子，肯為狗賊作飯耶！

translations.literal: When Shangzhou fell the bandits drove her to tend the cooking fires; she cursed, "I am a daughter of a great house, married to a great minister's son—would I cook for dog bandits!
translations.idiomatic: When Shangzhou fell the bandits forced her to cook. She cursed, "I am a daughter of a great house, married to a minister's son—would I cook for dog bandits!

sentences.zh: 」賊怒，斫其足，罵益厲，斷舌寸磔之。

translations.literal: " The bandits in anger hacked her feet; she cursed more fiercely; they cut out her tongue and dismembered her inch by inch.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits in anger hacked at her feet. She cursed all the more fiercely. They cut out her tongue and dismembered her piece by piece.

sentences.zh: 關陳諫妻呂氏。

translations.literal: Lady Lü, wife of Guan Chenjian.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Lü, wife of Guan Chenjian.

sentences.zh: 陳諫，雲夢諸生。

translations.literal: Chenjian was a licentiate of Yunmeng.
translations.idiomatic: Chenjian was a licentiate of Yunmeng.

sentences.zh: 族有安氏者，殉其夫關坤，呂每談及，輒感慨欷歔曰：「婦人義當如是。

translations.literal: In the clan was one of the An clan who died for her husband Guan Kun; whenever Lü spoke of it she would sigh with emotion and say, "A woman's righteousness ought to be thus.
translations.idiomatic: In the clan a woman of the An clan had died for her husband Guan Kun. Whenever Lü spoke of it she would sigh and say, "That is how a woman ought to act.

sentences.zh: 」崇禎末，寇陷鄰郡，呂謂夫曰：「賊焰方張，不如早為之所。

translations.literal: " At the end of Chongzhen invaders captured a neighboring prefecture; Lü told her husband, "The rebels' flame is just spreading—we had better make early provision.
translations.idiomatic: " At the end of the Chongzhen reign invaders captured a neighboring prefecture. Lü told her husband, "The rebels are spreading fast—we had better prepare while we can.

sentences.zh: 」取魚網結其體甚固。

translations.literal: " She took a fish net and bound their bodies very firmly.
translations.idiomatic: " She took a fish net and bound their bodies very tightly.

sentences.zh: 俄寇至，俾縫衣，呂投剪破賊面，罵曰：「賊敢辱我針黹乎！

translations.literal: Before long invaders arrived and made them sew garments; Lü threw scissors and cut the bandit's face, cursing, "How dare bandits insult my needlework!
translations.idiomatic: Before long the invaders arrived and made them sew clothes. Lü threw her scissors and cut a bandit's face, crying, "How dare you bandits insult my needlework!

sentences.zh: 手可斷，衣不可縫。

translations.literal: Hands can be severed—garments cannot be sewn.
translations.idiomatic: You may cut off my hands, but you will not make me sew.

sentences.zh: 」賊怒，磔之，投於水。

translations.literal: " The bandits in anger dismembered her on a stake and cast her into the water.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits in anger dismembered her on a stake and threw her into the water.

sentences.zh: 邵氏，曲周李純盛妻。

translations.literal: Lady Shao, wife of Li Chunsheng of Quzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Shao, wife of Li Chunsheng of Quzhou.

sentences.zh: 寇至，姑姊妹俱避地洞中。

translations.literal: When invaders arrived her mother-in-law and sisters-in-law all hid in an underground cave.
translations.idiomatic: When invaders arrived, her mother-in-law and sisters-in-law all hid in an underground cave.

sentences.zh: 邵為寇所得，問洞所在。

translations.literal: Shao was seized by invaders; they asked where the cave was.
translations.idiomatic: Shao was seized by the invaders, who asked where the cave was.

sentences.zh: 紿之行，寇喜隨之，徑往井傍，投井死。

translations.literal: She deceived them into going; the invaders gladly followed; she went straight to beside a well and threw herself in and died.
translations.idiomatic: She deceived them into following her. The invaders gladly went along. She led them straight to a well and threw herself in and died.

sentences.zh: 洞中五十余人俱獲免。

translations.literal: More than fifty people in the cave all escaped harm.
translations.idiomatic: More than fifty people in the cave were all spared.

sentences.zh: 王氏，宛平劉應龍妻。

translations.literal: Lady Wang, wife of Liu Yinglong of Wanping.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Wang, wife of Liu Yinglong of Wanping.

sentences.zh: 年十六，嫁應龍。

translations.literal: At sixteen she married Yinglong.
translations.idiomatic: At sixteen she married Yinglong.

sentences.zh: 家貧，以女紅養舅姑。

translations.literal: The family was poor; she supported her parents-in-law by needlework.
translations.idiomatic: The family was poor; she supported her parents-in-law with her needlework.

sentences.zh: 應龍父子相繼亡，王事姑撫子。

translations.literal: Yinglong and his father died one after another; Wang served her mother-in-law and raised her son.
translations.idiomatic: Yinglong and his father died in succession. Wang served her mother-in-law and raised her son.

sentences.zh: 閱二十年，賊陷都城，泣拜其姑曰：「留長孫奉事祖母，婦死已決。

translations.literal: After twenty years bandits captured the capital; weeping she bowed to her mother-in-law and said, "Leave the eldest grandson to serve Grandmother—this wife's death is already decided.
translations.idiomatic: After twenty years bandits captured the capital. Weeping, she bowed to her mother-in-law and said, "Leave the eldest grandson to serve you—this wife's death is already decided.

sentences.zh: 」遂攜幼子投井死。

translations.literal: " Thereupon she took her young son and threw herself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon she took her young son and threw herself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 吳之瑞妻張氏。

translations.literal: Lady Zhang, wife of Wu Zhirui.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhang, wife of Wu Zhirui.

sentences.zh: 之瑞，宿松諸生。

translations.literal: Zhirui was a licentiate of Susong.
translations.idiomatic: Zhirui was a licentiate of Susong.

sentences.zh: 福王時，城陷，軍士欲汙之。

translations.literal: In the time of the Prince of Fu the city fell; soldiers wished to defile her.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of the Prince of Fu the city fell, and soldiers meant to violate her.

sentences.zh: 張恐禍及夫與子，紿曰：「此吾家塾師，攜其子在此。

translations.literal: Zhang feared disaster would reach her husband and son; she deceived them, saying, "This is our household tutor—he has brought his son here.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang feared harm would come to her husband and son. She deceived them, saying, "This is our family tutor, and he has brought his son here.

sentences.zh: 吾醜之，若遣去，則惟命。

translations.literal: I find him repulsive—if you send him away, then it is only my fate.
translations.idiomatic: I find him repulsive. If you send him away, I will accept whatever comes.

sentences.zh: 」夫與二子去已遠，張乃厲聲唾罵，撞石死。

translations.literal: " Her husband and two sons had already gone far; Zhang then in a fierce voice spat curses and dashed against a stone and died.
translations.idiomatic: " Her husband and two sons were already far away. Zhang then cursed them loudly, dashed her head against a stone, and died.

sentences.zh: 韓鼎允妻劉氏。

translations.literal: Lady Liu, wife of Han Dingyun.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Liu, wife of Han Dingyun.

sentences.zh: 鼎允為懷寧諸生。

translations.literal: Dingyun was a licentiate of Huaining.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyun was a licentiate of Huaining.

sentences.zh: 福王時，城潰。

translations.literal: In the time of the Prince of Fu the city was breached.
translations.idiomatic: During the reign of the Prince of Fu the city was breached.

sentences.zh: 舅姑雙柩殯於堂，劉守不去。

translations.literal: Her parents-in-law's paired coffins lay in the hall; Liu guarded them and would not leave.
translations.idiomatic: Her parents-in-law's coffins lay side by side in the hall, and Liu stayed to guard them.

sentences.zh: 賊欲剖棺，劉抱棺號哭，賊釋之。

translations.literal: Bandits wished to open the coffins; Liu embraced the coffins and wailed; the bandits released them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits wanted to open the coffins. Liu clung to them and wailed until the bandits let them be.

sentences.zh: 一女年十三，賊欲縱火，而數盼其女。

translations.literal: A daughter was thirteen; the bandits wished to set fire and repeatedly glanced at her daughter.
translations.idiomatic: She had a thirteen-year-old daughter. The bandits meant to set a fire and kept looking at the girl.

sentences.zh: 劉紿之曰：「茍不驚先柩，女非所惜也。

translations.literal: Liu deceived them, saying, "If you do not disturb the former coffins, the girl is not what is cherished.
translations.idiomatic: Liu deceived them, saying, "If you do not disturb the coffins of the elders, the girl is nothing to me.

sentences.zh: 」賊喜投炬，攜女去。

translations.literal: " The bandits gladly threw torches and took the girl away.
translations.idiomatic: " The bandits gladly set the torches and took the girl away.

sentences.zh: 劉送女，目門外池示之，女即投池死。

translations.literal: Liu escorted her daughter, glancing at the pool outside the gate to signal her; the girl immediately threw herself into the pool and died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu walked her daughter out and signaled with her eyes toward the pool by the gate. The girl at once threw herself into the pool and died.

sentences.zh: 賊怒，刃劉，劉罵不絕口死。

translations.literal: The bandits in anger bladed Liu; Liu cursed without cease and died.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits in anger killed Liu with a blade. She cursed them to the end.

sentences.zh: 江都程氏六烈。

translations.literal: The Six Fiercely Chaste of the Cheng clan of Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: The Six Fiercely Chaste Women of the Cheng clan of Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 程煜節者，江都諸生也。

translations.literal: Cheng Yujie was a licentiate of Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Yujie was a licentiate of Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 其祖姑有適林者，其姑有適李者，其叔母曰劉氏、鄒氏、胡氏。

translations.literal: His grandfather's sister-in-law had married into the Lin clan; his father's sister had married into the Li clan; his uncles' wives were Lady Liu, Lady Zou, and Lady Hu.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather's sister-in-law had married into the Lin family; his father's sister had married into the Li family; his uncles' wives were Lady Liu, Lady Zou, and Lady Hu.

sentences.zh: 而煜節之妹曰程娥，未字。

translations.literal: And Yujie's younger sister was called Cheng E, not yet betrothed.
translations.idiomatic: Yujie's younger sister was called Cheng E and was not yet betrothed.

sentences.zh: 城被圍，與劉約俱死，各以大帶置袖中。

translations.literal: When the city was besieged she agreed with Liu to die together; each placed a large belt in her sleeve.
translations.idiomatic: When the city was besieged she and Liu agreed to die together, each keeping a long belt in her sleeve.

sentences.zh: 城破，女理發更衣，再拜別其母，遂縊死。

translations.literal: When the city fell the girl arranged her hair and changed clothes, twice bowed and took leave of her mother, then hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell the girl combed her hair, changed her clothes, bowed twice to her mother, and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 劉有女甫一歲，啼甚慘。

translations.literal: Liu had a daughter just one year old who wailed most pitifully.
translations.idiomatic: Liu had a daughter only one year old who wailed piteously.

sentences.zh: 劉乳之，復以糕餌一器置女側，乃死。

translations.literal: Liu nursed her, then placed a vessel of cakes and pastries beside the girl, and then died.
translations.idiomatic: Liu nursed her, set a bowl of cakes beside the child, and then died.

sentences.zh: 鄒與胡亦同死。

translations.literal: Zou and Hu also died together.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zou and Lady Hu died as well.

sentences.zh: 適林者，投井死。

translations.literal: She who had married into the Lin clan threw herself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: The woman who had married into the Lin family threw herself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 適李者，遭掠，紿卒至井旁，大罵投井死。

translations.literal: She who had married into the Li clan was seized; she deceived them until she reached beside a well, cursed loudly, and threw herself into the well and died.
translations.idiomatic: The woman who had married into the Li family was seized. She deceived her captors until she reached a well, cursed them loudly, and threw herself in.

sentences.zh: 時稱一門六烈。

translations.literal: At the time they were called six fiercely chaste in one household.
translations.idiomatic: At the time people called them six fiercely chaste women in a single household.

sentences.zh: 張氏，江都史著馨妻。

translations.literal: Lady Zhang, wife of Shi Zhuxin of Jiangdu.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Zhang, wife of Shi Zhuxin of Jiangdu.

sentences.zh: 年二十六，夫亡。

translations.literal: At twenty-six her husband died.
translations.idiomatic: At twenty-six her husband died.

sentences.zh: 及城陷，撫其子泣曰：「向也撫孤為難，今也全節為大。

translations.literal: When the city fell she embraced her son and wept, saying, "Before, raising the orphan was the hardship; now preserving integrity is the greater matter.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell she embraced her son and wept, saying, "Before, raising an orphan alone was the hard part; now keeping my integrity intact is what matters most.

sentences.zh: 兒其善圖，吾不能顧矣。

translations.literal: Son, plan well for yourself—I can no longer attend to you.
translations.idiomatic: My son, make your own way—I can no longer look after you.

sentences.zh: 」遂赴水死。

translations.literal: " Thereupon she went into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon she went into the water and died.

sentences.zh: 又蘭氏，孫道升繼妻。

translations.literal: Also Lady Lan, second wife of Sun Daosheng.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Lady Lan, second wife of Sun Daosheng.

sentences.zh: 其前妻女曰四，蘭所生女曰七，皆嫁古氏。

translations.literal: His former wife's daughter was called Si, Lan's own daughter was called Qi—both had married into the Gu clan.
translations.idiomatic: His first wife's daughter was called Si; Lan's own daughter was called Qi—both had married into the Gu family.

sentences.zh: 次曰存，孫女曰巽，皆未嫁。

translations.literal: Next was Cun; Sun's granddaughter was called Xun—all were unmarried.
translations.idiomatic: Next came Cun; Sun's granddaughter was called Xun—all were still unmarried.

sentences.zh: 其弟道乾、道新並先卒。

translations.literal: His younger brothers Daogan and Daoxin had both died before him.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brothers Daogan and Daoxin had both died before him.

sentences.zh: 道乾妻王氏，子天麟妻丁氏，道新妻古氏，其從弟子啟先妻董氏。

translations.literal: Daogan's wife was Lady Wang; son Tianlin's wife was Lady Ding; Daoxin's wife was Lady Gu; his collateral nephew Qixian's wife was Lady Dong.
translations.idiomatic: Daogan's wife was Lady Wang; his son Tianlin's wife was Lady Ding; Daoxin's wife was Lady Gu; and his cousin Qixian's wife was Lady Dong.

sentences.zh: 江都之圍，諸婦女各手一刃一繩自隨。

translations.literal: During the siege of Jiangdu all the women each kept a blade and a cord at hand.
translations.idiomatic: During the siege of Jiangdu each of the women kept a blade and a cord with her at all times.

sentences.zh: 城破，巽先縊死。

translations.literal: When the city fell Xun first hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Xun was the first to hang herself.

sentences.zh: 蘭時五十四，引繩自縊死。

translations.literal: Lan was then fifty-four; she drew the cord and hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: Lan was then fifty-four. She took up her cord and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 王氏、丁氏投舍後汪中死。

translations.literal: Lady Wang and Lady Ding cast themselves into Houwang Pond and died.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Wang and Lady Ding threw themselves into Houwang Pond and died.

sentences.zh: 古氏亦五十四，守節三十年，頭盡白，投井死。

translations.literal: Lady Gu was also fifty-four; she had kept her chastity for thirty years, her hair entirely white; she threw herself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Gu was also fifty-four. She had preserved her chastity for thirty years until her hair was wholly white, then cast herself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 有女嫁於吳，生女曰睿，方八歲，適在外家，從死於井。

translations.literal: She had a daughter married into Wu, who bore a daughter called Rui, just eight years old; she happened to be at her mother's family home and followed them to death in the well.
translations.idiomatic: She had a daughter married into the Wu family, who bore a daughter named Rui, only eight years old. The child happened to be visiting her mother's kin and followed them into the well to die.

sentences.zh: 董氏以帶系門樞，縊死。

translations.literal: Lady Dong tied her belt to the door pivot and hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Dong fastened her belt to the door pivot and hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 存病足，力疾投井死。

translations.literal: Cun had a diseased foot; forcing herself despite illness she threw herself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: Cun had an afflicted foot; straining herself despite the illness, she threw herself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 董氏之娣，有祖母曰陳氏，方寄居，與董氏同處，亦自縊死。

translations.literal: Lady Dong's younger sister-in-law had a grandmother called Lady Chen, who was then living as a guest; dwelling together with Lady Dong, she too hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Dong's sister-in-law had a grandmother, Lady Chen, who was then staying as a guest. Living together with Lady Dong, she hanged herself as well.

sentences.zh: 四與七同縊於床死。

translations.literal: Si and Qi hanged themselves together on the bed and died.
translations.idiomatic: Si and Qi hanged themselves together on the bed and died.

sentences.zh: 同時有張廷鉉者，妻薛氏，城破自縊死。

translations.literal: At the same time there was Zhang Tingxian; his wife Lady Xue, when the city fell, hanged herself and died.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time there was Zhang Tingxian, whose wife Lady Xue hanged herself when the city fell.

sentences.zh: 廷鉉之妹曰五，遇卒鞭撻使從己，大呼曰：「殺即殺，何鞭為！

translations.literal: Tingxian's younger sister, called Wu, encountered a soldier who flogged her to make her follow him; she cried out loudly, saying, "If you are going to kill me, then kill me—why the flogging!
translations.idiomatic: Tingxian's younger sister, called Wu, met a soldier who beat her to make her go with him. She cried out, "Kill me if you will—why whip me!

sentences.zh: 」遂殺死。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they killed her.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they killed her.

sentences.zh: 張秉純妻劉氏。

translations.literal: Lady Liu, wife of Zhang Bingchun.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Liu, wife of Zhang Bingchun.

sentences.zh: 秉純，和州諸生。

translations.literal: Bingchun was a licentiate of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bingchun was a licentiate of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 家故貧，氏操井臼，處之怡然。

translations.literal: The family had long been poor; Lady Liu managed the mortar and pestle and bore it contentedly.
translations.idiomatic: The family had always been poor. Lady Liu worked the mortar and pestle and took it cheerfully.

sentences.zh: 國亡，秉純絕粒死。

translations.literal: When the state perished, Bingchun refused food and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the dynasty fell, Bingchun starved himself to death.

sentences.zh: 氏一勺水不入口，閱十有六日，肌骨銷鑠，命子扶至柩前祭拜，痛哭而絕。

translations.literal: Lady Liu would not let a single spoonful of water pass her lips; after fully sixteen days her flesh and bones were wasted away; she ordered her son to support her before the coffin to pay ritual obeisance, wept bitterly, and expired.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Liu would not take even a spoonful of water. After sixteen full days her flesh and bones were wasted away. She had her son help her to the coffin to bow in farewell, wept bitterly, and died.

sentences.zh: 陶氏，當塗孫士毅妻，守節十年。

translations.literal: Lady Tao, wife of Sun Shiyi of Dangtu, had kept her chastity for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Tao, wife of Sun Shiyi of Dangtu, had preserved her chastity for ten years.

sentences.zh: 南都覆，為卒所掠，縛其手介刃於兩指之間，曰：「從我則完，否則裂。

translations.literal: When the Southern Capital fell, she was seized by a soldier; they bound her hands and wedged a blade between her fingers, saying, "If you follow me you will remain whole; if not, they will be split.
translations.idiomatic: When the Southern Capital fell, she was seized by a soldier who bound her hands and wedged a blade between her fingers, saying, "Come with me and you stay whole; refuse and I split them.

sentences.zh: 」陶曰：「義不以身辱，速盡為惠。

translations.literal: " Tao said, "By righteousness I will not let my body be disgraced—quick death would be a kindness.
translations.idiomatic: " Lady Tao said, "I will not let my body be shamed for righteousness' sake—a swift death would be a mercy.

sentences.zh: 」兵不忍殺，稍創其指，血流竟手，曰：「從乎？

translations.literal: " The soldier could not bear to kill her and only lightly wounded her fingers; blood flowed to cover her hands; he said, "Will you follow?
translations.idiomatic: " The soldier could not bring himself to kill her and only cut her fingers lightly until blood covered her hands. He asked, "Will you follow?

sentences.zh: 」曰：「不從。

translations.literal: " She said, "I will not follow.
translations.idiomatic: " She said, "I will not.

sentences.zh: 」卒怒，裂其手而下，且剜其胸，寸磔死。

translations.literal: " The soldier in anger tore off her hand, then gouged out her breast and put her to death by inch-measure dismemberment.
translations.idiomatic: " The soldier in fury tore off her hand, gouged out her breast, and dismembered her inch by inch until she died.

sentences.zh: 陶母奔護，亦被殺。

translations.literal: Lady Tao's mother ran to shield her and was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Tao's mother rushed to shield her and was killed as well.

sentences.zh: 田氏，儀真李鐵匠妻，姿甚美。

translations.literal: Lady Tian, wife of Li the blacksmith of Yizhen, was of very beautiful appearance.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Tian, wife of Li the blacksmith of Yizhen, was exceedingly beautiful.

sentences.zh: 高傑步卒掠江上，執犯之，田以死拒。

translations.literal: Gao Jie's foot soldiers plundered along the river; seizing her they would violate her; Tian resisted unto death.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Jie's foot soldiers raided along the river. Seizing her they tried to assault her, but Tian resisted to the death.

sentences.zh: 挾馬上，至城南小橋，馬不能渡。

translations.literal: They forced her onto a horse; reaching a small bridge south of the city, the horse could not cross.
translations.idiomatic: They forced her onto a horse. At a small bridge south of the city the horse could not cross.

sentences.zh: 田紿卒牽衣行，睹中流急湍，曳二卒赴水，並溺死。

translations.literal: Tian deceived the soldiers into pulling her by the garment as they walked; seeing the swift current midstream, she dragged the two soldiers into the water and all drowned together.
translations.idiomatic: Tian tricked the soldiers into leading her by the robe. Seeing the swift midstream current, she pulled both soldiers into the water and all three drowned.

sentences.zh: 王氏，和州諸生張侶顏妻。

translations.literal: Lady Wang, wife of Zhang Lüyan, licentiate of Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Wang, wife of Zhang Lüyan, a licentiate of Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 南都不守，劉良佐部卒肆掠。

translations.literal: When the Southern Capital was lost to defense, the troops of Liu Liangzuo plundered at will.
translations.idiomatic: When the Southern Capital fell, the soldiers under Liu Liangzuo looted without restraint.

sentences.zh: 氏同母匿朝陽洞，卒攻洞急，氏以子付母曰：「賊勢洶洶，我少婦，即茍免，何面目回夫家。

translations.literal: Lady Wang and her mother hid in Chaoyang Cave; soldiers pressed the attack on the cave; she entrusted her son to her mother, saying, "The bandits' fury is overwhelming; I am a young wife—even if I were meanly spared, what face could I show returning to my husband's family.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Wang hid with her mother in Chaoyang Cave as soldiers pressed the attack. She handed her son to her mother and said, "The rebels are raging; I am a young wife. Even if I were vilely spared, what face could I show returning to my husband's house?

sentences.zh: 此張氏一線，善撫之。
